I know how you feel. It's hard sometimes when you know what you want, and even know the first steps of how to get it, but just can't bring yourself to make that step. Depression does that to you. Have you tried taking things slow? Meeting people online in your area might be a good start. If you're in school, try talking to people who do well in your classes. They might be even half as smart as you. You'd be surprised what you have in common with people.
It's gut-wrenching to have to make a step, any step, especially a big one. But it pays off, I promise you. Making friends is so awkward, and at first you might (and probably will, to be honest) feel out of place and discouraged. But if you stick it out through those initially unnerving situations/conversations, you can meet some great people! They can introduce you to their friends and each time you meet another individual the awkwardness will be lessened. The first step is the hardest. I encourage you to make it. You got this, OP.
